items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: I played there a good while for him.

ctx.x: This is a tiny firearm here Punch known as Blue Moon Blues. Now the other side is doing the Jug Jug. There's no personnel listed here. In some of the records it just says that you're featured. Now I'm just trying to see if you...
I played there a good while for him.
